# Electrodry Carpet Cleaning Melbourne
### Business Hours
Mon–Sat: 8:00am – 4:30pm (service); 8:00am – 6:00pm (online booking). Sun: Closed (service); 8:00am – 4:00pm (online booking).

Clean, soft, walk-on dry carpet! Includes Electro-Shield™ long-lasting bacteria and germ protection.
## Why Electrodry Is The Best Carpet Cleaning in Melbourne

Electrodry’s cutting-edge dry carpet cleaning system is the ideal solution for Melbourne’s busy homes and tired floors. Our low-moisture process thoroughly cleans and refreshes your carpets, leaving them dry and ready to use in 1-2 hours. Say goodbye to musty odours and hello to a cleaner, healthier, and more comfortable home.
### Walk-On Dry Right Away — Clean carpets you can walk on 1-2 hours after we're done.
### Long-Lasting Germ Defence — Electro-Shield™ keeps germs and bacteria at bay for longer.
### Removes Stains Better — Electrodry’s unique dry cleaning system tackles more stains than other methods.
### No Damp Carpet Smell — Forget the soggy odours - just a light, fresh lemony scent.
### Gentle on Your Carpet — No excess water or heat, so your carpets won't shrink or stretch.
### Thorough Pre-Vacuum To Remove Dry Soils — Carpets are pre-vacuumed using industrial-strength equipment to remove dry dirt from the carpet and open up the fibres for cleaning.
### Stain Pre-Treatment & Application Of Dry Cleaning Solutions — Problem areas are treated with specialised dry cleaning products and stain removal solutions.
### Exclusive Carpet Dry Cleaning System With Conditioning Rinse — Our Carpet Dry Cleaning system and conditioning rinse will reset the carpet's chemical balance.
### Application Of Electro-Shield™ & Carpet Grooming — Finally, Electro-Shield™ is applied to treat germs and bacteria. The carpets are groomed to reset the pile and promote faster drying. Included with every carpet cleaning service. Electro-Shield™ keeps working to protect you and your family for up to 3 months after we’ve cleaned your carpet.
## Carpet Cleaning Melbourne – Local Experts for Over 40 Years

For over 40 years, Electrodry has been the trusted choice for carpet cleaning in Melbourne homes. As part of a leading national network of cleaning experts, we are proud to deliver high-quality carpet and lounge cleaning services tailored to Melbourne's unique needs. Our Melbourne team, led by Simon Jones, combines local expertise with industry-leading techniques. Melbourne's variable climate can be tough on carpets, from damp winters to dusty summers. Our advanced dry cleaning system ensures carpets are fresh, clean, and walk-on dry in just 1–2 hours.
### Melbourne Service Areas

We provide professional carpet and upholstery cleaning across Melbourne and beyond — from Werribee in the west to Yarra Junction in the east, Whittlesea and Kyneton in the north, and all the way down the Mornington Peninsula to Portsea. Inner Melbourne: Carlton, Fitzroy, Richmond, South Yarra. Eastern Suburbs: Box Hill, Doncaster, Ringwood, Croydon, Yarra Junction. Western Suburbs: Werribee, Sunshine, Williamstown, Hoppers Crossing. Northern Suburbs: Epping, Craigieburn, Reservoir, Greensborough, Whittlesea, Kyneton. Bayside & Peninsula: Brighton, St Kilda, Frankston, Moorabbin, Dandenong, Cranbourne, Mornington, Portsea.
